scope: Fuse ordinary LDM/STM setup into first memory beat and eligible incrementing base writeback into last beat

psr_audit.scope: PSR/CP15 serialization audit; no RTL changes
source_findings: Flags-only MSR and unchanged low CPSR byte already continue without a resync in zap_alu_main flags_bp_feedback.
Real mode/state/IRQ-mask changes retain resync, which is needed for bank/interrupt visibility.
MRS is ordinary FADD, SPSR writes ordinary MMOV; neither uses the CP15 drain state.
Privileged MRC/MCR currently drain i_pipeline_dav before starting the CP15 transaction.
MRC ACTIVE can potentially combine its registered RF-write request and completion, but requires timing/IRQ/fault/dependency/handshake tests; not implemented.
limits: The original bitmap converter has zero PSR/CP15 operations; this does not measure Symbian OS overhead or the rest of JPEG decode/encode.
Unverified proposal is not a measured performance improvement.

jpeg_instruction_mix.meaning: Original 8x8 bitmap diffusion routine, not full JPEG codec

failed_fixture_approaches: Initial abstract oracle checked an address from condition-failed uops; corrected to check only executed addresses.
Initial abort fixture used unencodable CMP immediate0x101; changed distinct test patterns to encodable small constants.
First negative-control expectation named wrong-address while the variant correctly failed earlier on an architectural register.
